mapper.select: SELECT allocation.tenant_id, allocation.allocation_id, allocation.event_id, allocation.reversal_of_id AS original_allocation_id, event.reversal_of_id AS original_event_id, allocation.employee_id, allocation.sales_user_id, allocation.dept_id, event.event_type, event.biz_type, event.biz_id, event.currency, event.occurred_time, allocation.allocated_amount, allocation.commission_rate, allocation.commission_amount, event.baseline_flag, allocation.commission_status, allocation.comp_change_id FROM crm_deal_allocation allocation JOIN crm_deal_event event ON event.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND event.event_id = allocation.event_id WHERE allocation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND allocation.allocation_id = #{allocationId}

SELECT allocation.allocation_id, allocation.event_id, allocation.reversal_of_id, event.event_type, event.biz_type, event.biz_id, customer.customer_name, event.occurred_time, COALESCE(receivable.receivable_name, opportunity.opportunity_name, contract.contract_name) AS business_name, event.currency, event.team_version, event.baseline_flag, allocation.sales_user_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(sales.nick_name, ''), sales.user_name) AS sales_user_name, allocation.dept_id, department.dept_name, allocation.role_type, allocation.allocated_percentage, allocation.allocated_amount, customer.dept_id AS scope_dept_id, customer.owner_id AS scope_owner_id
, allocation.commission_rate, allocation.commission_amount, allocation.commission_status, allocation.comp_change_id, change_item.payroll_period_id, period.period_name AS payroll_period_name, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM outbox_event request WHERE request.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND request.aggregate_type = 'cloudflow-service-crm' AND request.aggregate_id = allocation.allocation_id AND request.event_type = 'CRM_COMMISSION_REQUEST') AS commission_requested, JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT((SELECT audit.after_data FROM hr_audit_log audit WHERE audit.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND audit.business_domain = 'CRM_COMMISSION' AND audit.business_id = allocation.comp_change_id AND audit.operation_type = 'COMMISSION_PROGRESS' ORDER BY audit.id DESC LIMIT 1), '$.state')) AS payroll_state
FROM crm_deal_allocation allocation JOIN crm_deal_event event ON event.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND event.event_id = allocation.event_id JOIN crm_customer customer ON customer.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND customer.customer_id = event.customer_id AND customer.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN crm_receivable receivable ON event.biz_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND receivable.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND receivable.receivable_id = event.biz_id LEFT JOIN crm_opportunity opportunity ON event.biz_type = 'OPPORTUNITY' AND opportunity.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND opportunity.opportunity_id = event.biz_id LEFT JOIN oa_contract contract ON event.biz_type = 'CONTRACT' AND contract.tenant_id = event.tenant_id AND contract.contract_id = event.biz_id LEFT JOIN sys_user sales ON sales.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND sales.user_id = allocation.sales_user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept department ON department.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND department.dept_id = allocation.dept_id
LEFT JOIN hr_comp_change change_item ON change_item.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND change_item.id = allocation.comp_change_id AND change_item.source_biz_type = 'CRM_COMMISSION' AND change_item.source_biz_id = CAST(allocation.allocation_id AS CHAR) LEFT JOIN hr_payroll_period period ON period.tenant_id = allocation.tenant_id AND period.period_id = change_item.payroll_period_id
WHERE allocation.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND event.occurred_time >= #{filters.startDate} AND event.occurred_time < DATE_ADD(#{filters.endDate}, INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND event.currency = #{filters.currency} AND event.event_type = #{filters.eventType} AND event.biz_type = #{filters.bizType} AND event.biz_id = #{filters.bizId} ORDER BY event.occurred_time DESC, event.event_id DESC, allocation.allocation_id

SELECT change_item.id AS comp_change_id, change_item.source_biz_type, change_item.source_biz_id, change_item.employee_id, change_item.deleted, change_item.payroll_period_id, change_item.salary_component_id, change_item.status, (SELECT audit.after_data FROM hr_audit_log audit WHERE audit.tenant_id = change_item.tenant_id AND audit.business_domain = 'CRM_COMMISSION' AND audit.business_id = change_item.id AND audit.operation_type = 'COMMISSION_PROGRESS' ORDER BY audit.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS audit_json FROM hr_comp_change change_item WHERE change_item.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND change_item.id = #{compChangeId}
SELECT after_val FROM sys_audit_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND biz_module = 'crm' AND audit_name = '核定到账提成' AND audit_field = CAST(#{allocationId} AS CHAR) ORDER BY audit_id DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT period_id AS id, CONCAT(period_name, ' · ', start_date, ' 至 ', end_date) AS name FROM hr_payroll_period WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'OPEN' ORDER BY start_date DESC, period_id DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT id, component_name AS name FROM hr_comp_component WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 1 AND component_type = 'VARIABLE' AND taxable = 1 ORDER BY sort_order, id LIMIT 200
